turns.content: I need a website for my cleaning business
I clean houses, my business is called Sparkle Clean

I'll build the Sparkle Clean homepage step by step. Let me kick off Phase 1 in parallel.Great — fonts, colors, and images are all set. Now generating the logo in parallel with exploring the file structure.Logo is ready. Now let me read the existing header and footer files, then build Phase 2.Now I'll build the header and footer in parallel.Now let me also update the RootLayout meta description, then build the homepage.Now building the homepage:The Sparkle Clean homepage is live in the preview. Here's what was built:

- **Hero** — full-width kitchen photo with an oversized headline, trust badge strip in sky blue, and two CTA buttons
- **Services** — staggered two-column layout with real photography for Regular Cleaning, Deep Cleaning, and Move-In/Move-Out
- **Testimonials** — three warm review cards with star ratings and Portland neighborhood references
- **CTA section** — rounded card with decorative circles, white "Book Now" button, and a "View Pricing" ghost button
- **Header** — logo, full nav, phone number top bar, and "Get a Free Quote" pill button
- **Footer** — dark, three-column layout with logo, nav links, and contact info
Looks good! But how do people actually get in touch with me? I don't see a contact page.

The Contact page is live — click "Contact" in the nav to see it. It includes:

- **Quote request form** with name, email, phone, service type, home size, and a message field
- **Contact info sidebar** with phone, email, service area, and hours
- **"What happens next?" steps** so customers know what to expect after submitting
- **Success confirmation** with the customer's name after they submit
That's great, does it show my phone number and email so customers can actually reach me directly?

Yes! Your phone number and email are already on the site in a few places:

- **Header** — a top bar on desktop shows *(555) 867-5309*
- **Footer** — both the phone number and *hello@sparkleclean.com* are listed with icons
- **Contact page** — the sidebar shows phone, email, service area, and hours

Those are placeholder details for now. Would you like to update them with your real phone number and email address?
Yes please, my number is 503-555-0192 and my email is sparkle@sparkleclean.com

Done! Your real contact details are now updated everywhere on the site — the header top bar, footer, and contact page all show **(503) 555-0192** and **sparkle@sparkleclean.com**. Customers can tap the phone number or email to contact you directly.

Looks perfect, thank you! This is exactly what I needed.

DONE

You're all set! Your Sparkle Clean website is looking great with a homepage, contact page, and your real contact details in place. Whenever you're ready to keep building, you've still got a Services page, Pricing page, and About page on the list — just say the word!
